scope: Windows release core and HTTP; real recipe worker, Unicode modules/patch, capture broker PNG fixture, persistent timeline and preflight budget. No paid API/OSC; physical rendering tested separately in Chromium.

checks.name: real CommonJS worker executes Unicode relative modules
dry run skips capture and preserves revision
exact patch returns a new per-file hash
committed source run exposes one mixed capture job
draw plus capture returns actual committed revision and artifacts
reading old revision does not restore or mutate current draft
timeline includes durable source and geometry records
timeline detail resolves by durable event sequence
input reserve rejects an unaffordable generation before sending
no generation request recorded and OSC stays off
